senses.zh: 整平土地（如用來做院子）
senses.en: to level the ground to make front yard
the part of a trap, a very small piece of wood which is hooked at dikit and lamatat, and which is connected by a string to an erected bambo stick, or flexible piece of wood.
to chirp (as a group of birds)

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.227，paraw- 條下派生詞

senses.en: to have a new year, to celebrate the New Year
